source: That’s truly unfortunate, Mr. Flynn… I had no doubt you would’ve been a breakout star in the culinary industry.
translation: 真是遗憾，Flynn先生……我毫不怀疑你本来会成为烹饪界的一颗新星。

source: I understand, Mr. Clermont, but I’m already satisfied with where I am.
translation: 我明白，Clermont先生，但我已经满足于现在的生活了。

source: I know I’ll be happy being Camp Buddy’s special chef!
translation: 我知道，只要成为 Camp Buddy 的专属厨师，我就会感到幸福！

source: Haha, well it sounds like you’ve fully made up your mind! I won’t try and convince you any further!
translation: 哈哈，看来你已经完全下定决心了！我不会再继续劝你了！

source: You can relax and not concern yourself about this anymore, but I would like to express that the offer will stay on the table!
translation: 你可以放心，不必再为这件事操心了，不过我还是想说明，这份邀请一直有效！

source: Consider it an open opportunity should you ever change your mind.
translation: 如果你以后改变主意，就把它当作一个随时可以接受的机会。

source: I really appreciate your generosity, Mr. Clermont. Thank you for giving me a chance.
translation: 我真的很感激您的慷慨，Clermont先生。谢谢您给我这个机会。

source: Of course! Until next time!
translation: 当然！下次见！

source: You did great, Aiden! You were very professional, and everything you said came from the heart.
translation: 你做得很棒，Aiden！你表现得非常专业，而且说的每句话都发自内心。

source: Especially when it’s about turning down something I tried reaching for in the past.
translation: 尤其是拒绝我过去曾努力争取过的东西时。

source: In my head, I wasn’t just following in my dad’s footsteps, but also trying to fulfill my end of our promise to be back together.
translation: 在我心里，我不只是想追随爸爸的脚步，也在努力履行我们重逢的承诺。

source: Well… It was only when I got the job here that I found out you lost your dad…
translation: 嗯……直到我在这里得到这份工作，才知道你失去了父亲……

source: Even still, I tried to save face by convincing everyone that I was only coming back to make enough money for college.
translation: 即便如此，我还是试图挽回面子，告诉大家我只是回来赚够大学学费。

source: When deep inside… All I wanted was to be back.
translation: 但在内心深处……我想要的只是回来。

source: I wish I’d had the courage to ask you how exactly things went down when we were apart.
translation: 我真希望自己当时有勇气问你，我们分开期间究竟发生了什么。

source: I knew you were trying to move on, so I didn’t want to bring it up unless you did.
translation: 我知道你在努力向前看，所以除非你主动提起，我不想把这件事说出来。

source: I know it’s inexcusable, especially since I’m the only one you would’ve counted on.
translation: 我知道这是不可原谅的，尤其是因为我本该是你唯一可以依靠的人。

source: Don’t blame yourself, Yoshi. I was the one who chose to hide everything from you.
translation: 别责怪自己，Yoshi。是我选择把一切都瞒着你。

source: You were on your first job as an official scoutmaster at the time.
translation: 那时你刚开始担任正式童军团长的第一份工作。

source: And considering you were left in charge of the entire camp with lots of staff and scouts, I saw how much you were dealing with.
translation: 而且考虑到你被留下来负责整个营地，还要管理那么多员工和童军，我看得出你要处理的事情有多少。

source: I really didn’t want to burden you more… I was just happy enough to be with you again.
translation: 我真的不想再给你增添负担……能再次和你在一起，我就已经很满足了。

source: …I’d say your best quality is the way you always hold your head high and look at things so positively.
translation: ……我想说，你最大的优点，就是无论发生什么，你总能抬起头来，积极地看待一切。

source: Hehe, you sure it’s not my jacked bod and charming personality?
translation: 嘿嘿，你确定不是我健美的身材和迷人的性格？

source: Of course, I love that about you just as much.
translation: 当然，我也同样喜欢你的这些优点。

source: But in all seriousness, you never showed anyone a sign of what you had to go through.
translation: 但说真的，你从没让任何人看出自己经历了什么。

source: Not only were you always cheerful, but you were ready to help me and the camp out any way you could.
translation: 你不仅总是那么开朗，还会尽己所能帮助我和营地。

source: Even when everyone left Camp Buddy after last year’s scandal, you were the only one who stuck around.
translation: 即使去年那场丑闻后所有人都离开了 Camp Buddy，你仍然是唯一留下来的人。

source: I honestly don’t know where I’d have ended up if you weren’t there for me…
translation: 如果不是有你陪着我，我真不知道自己最后会变成什么样……

source: So, I’m really thankful, Aiden…
translation: 所以，我真的很感谢你，Aiden……

source: Aww, you’re gonna make me tear up, Yoshi…
translation: 哎呀，你要把我弄哭了，Yoshi……

source: But hey, you’ve done as much for me. And not just by taking me back and giving me a home again.
translation: 不过，嘿，你也为我做了同样多的事。不只是带我回来，又给了我一个家。

source: Working with you these last few years made me feel useful – it helped me to move past my pain.
translation: 过去几年和你一起工作，让我觉得自己很有用——也帮助我走出了痛苦。

source: And once you guys made me a scoutmaster, I really felt like I belonged here.
translation: 而且当你们让我的身份变成童军团长后，我真的觉得自己属于这里。

source: I couldn’t have asked for anything more… So, I just wanted that to last for as long as I could.
translation: 我没法再奢求更多了……所以，我只希望这一切能尽可能长久地持续下去。

source: And now, with the choice you made, it’s going to last forever.
translation: 而现在，有了你的选择，这一切会永远持续下去。

source: Yeah, exactly!
translation: 没错，就是这样！

source: I used to believe that I didn’t have a choice with what life threw at me, so I just let things happen and felt content as they were.
translation: 我以前相信，面对生活抛给我的一切，我没有选择，所以只能任由事情发生，满足于现状。

source: But if there’s something I realized from all this… I’ve always been making decisions for myself.
translation: 但如果说我从这一切中意识到了什么……那就是，我一直都在为自己做决定。

source: From choosing to try and pursue a career despite failing, to accepting your offer to return and staying despite everything that happened along the way…
translation: 从即使失败也选择尝试追求事业，到接受你的邀请回来，并在经历了一切之后选择留下……

source: Now, I chose something I truly want for myself.
translation: 现在，我选择了自己真正想要的东西。

source: So, thanks for staying by my side and supporting my decision, Yoshi.
translation: 所以，谢谢你一直陪在我身边，支持我的决定，Yoshi。

source: Of course, Aiden… I’ll always be here for you.
translation: 当然，Aiden……我永远都会在你身边。

source: Phew… Finally, I got all that off my chest…
translation: 呼……终于把这些话全说出来了……

source: Making that decision gave me some real closure.
translation: 做出这个决定，让我真正释怀了。

source: I’m done being stuck in my ways and just going with the flow, sweeping every bad thing under the rug and thinking it’d all go away.
translation: 我不再固守己见、随波逐流，把所有坏事都藏到地毯下，以为它们会自行消失。

source: From now on, I won’t let anything take my happiness away!
translation: 从今以后，我不会让任何事情夺走我的幸福！

source: I’m really proud of you, Aiden!
translation: 我真的为你感到骄傲，Aiden！

source: Sheesh, so this is what it’s like to be cheesy.
translation: 啧，原来肉麻起来是这种感觉。

source: Can’t believe it took me this long to catch it from you, considering how much we’re stuck together. Hahaha!
translation: 真不敢相信我们总是形影不离，我却花了这么久才被你传染上，哈哈哈！

source: I hate to break it to you but you’re just gonna have to deal with me forever.
translation: 很遗憾地告诉你，你以后只能永远和我相处了。

source: Oho~ You tellin’ me we’re gonna be more than just boyfriends now?
translation: 哦呵～你的意思是，我们现在不只是男朋友了？

source: Well, I ended up turning down the offer. I don’t think it was the right path for me, Gramps.
translation: 嗯，我最后还是拒绝了这份邀请。我不认为那是适合我的道路，Gramps。

source: I had a feeling that you’d end up choosing that, Aiden.
translation: 我就猜到你最后会做出这个选择，Aiden。

source: What?! I was sure you and everybody else’d be shocked.
translation: 什么？！我还以为你和其他人都会大吃一惊。

source: Pretty sure what I just did goes against the norm.
translation: 我很确定自己刚才做的事不合常规。

source: Nonsense! As long as you’re happy, whatever your decision, it’ll always be the right choice.
translation: 胡说！只要你感到幸福，无论你做什么决定，它都会是正确的选择。

source: I support you regardless. And I think that applies to the rest of us here at Camp Buddy as well.
translation: 无论如何我都支持你。我想 Camp Buddy 的其他人也都一样。

source: Hehe, I love it when you take charge like that, Sir Goro. Reminds me of when we were scouts!
translation: 嘿嘿，我喜欢你这样果断，Goro先生。让我想起我们当童军的时候！

source: Haha, here we go with fanboy Yoshi.
translation: 哈哈，又来了，迷弟Yoshi。

source: I mean it, though! It’s one thing to lead the scouts, but it takes a whole other level of skill to coordinate a project like this.
translation: 我是认真的！带领童军是一回事，但要协调这样的项目，则需要完全不同层次的能力。

source: You don’t have to tell me twice – no way I’d be able to do what Gramps does, haha!
translation: 你不用说第二遍——我可没法做到Gramps那样，哈哈！

source: Thank you both. I only push through because of all of you.
translation: 谢谢你们。我之所以坚持下去，全都因为有你们。

source: I believe we all share the same sentiment that working at Camp Buddy is more than just a job for all of us.
translation: 我相信对我们所有人来说，在 Camp Buddy 工作不只是一份工作，我们都有同样的感受。

source: I’m pretty proud of what we’ve accomplished considering we’re a small group of people with humble beginnings.
translation: 考虑到我们只是从不起眼的起点起步的一小群人，我真的很为我们取得的成就感到骄傲。

source: We may be just a temporary place for our scouts, but I’d like to believe that the memories we give them lasts forever.
translation: 我们也许只是童军们暂时停留的地方，但我愿意相信，我们带给他们的回忆会永远留存。

source: There’s a sense of fulfillment that what we’re doing here makes a difference even in the littlest way possible.
translation: 看到我们在这里所做的事哪怕以最微小的方式也能带来改变，这让我感到一种满足。

source: Sheesh… Now I know where Yoshi got his speeches from.
translation: 啧……现在我知道Yoshi的演讲都是从哪儿学来的了。

source: Aiden…!
translation: Aiden……！

source: Speaking of which, Yoshinori here will have to take my place someday.
translation: 说到这个，Yoshinori总有一天要接替我的位置。

source: Don’t you have a little over a decade before you retire, Gramps?
translation: Gramps，你离退休不是还有十多年吗？

source: *ehem* I’m just saying that with the camp growing like it is, we need to get someone ready to carry on the torch.
translation: *咳咳* 我只是说，既然营地发展成这样，我们需要培养一个人来接过火炬。

source: Did you ever expect Camp Buddy to blow up like this, sir?
translation: 先生，您以前想过 Camp Buddy 会发展成这样吗？

source: Honestly, no. I’m sure if my younger self could see me now, he’d be over the moon.
translation: 老实说，没有。我敢肯定，如果年轻时的我能看到现在的自己，一定会欣喜若狂。

source: But even then, a part of me always hoped this camp would become something more because we were all pouring our hearts into it.
translation: 但即使如此，我内心始终希望这个营地能发展得更好，因为我们所有人都在为它倾注心血。

source: There were plenty of hardships along the way, but I don’t regret any of them. They helped shape everything into what we have today.
translation: 一路上遇到了许多困难，但我不后悔其中任何一个。正是它们让一切变成了今天的样子。

source: Sounds like I’m not the only one who’s got plenty to unpack~
translation: 看来不只是我有一大堆心事要慢慢整理～

source: Well, I’d be glad to tell you more after everything settles down. So, let’s save that for a different time.
translation: 等一切稳定下来后，我很乐意再多告诉你一些。所以，我们改天再说吧。

source: Yes, sir! We’ll make sure everything gets done on time!
translation: 是，先生！我们会确保一切按时完成！

source: Good. I’m counting on you both!
translation: 很好。我就靠你们两个了！

source: Gramps sounded exactly like he was back then, huh? Burning with passion.
translation: Gramps听起来和那时一模一样，对吧？充满了热情。

source: Yeah, to think that less than a year ago he wanted nothing to do with Camp Buddy, or us, anymore.
translation: 是啊，真难以想象，不到一年前他还不想再和 Camp Buddy，或者和我们，有任何关系。

source: I’m so glad he was able to move past all of that!
translation: 我很高兴他终于走出了那一切！

source: Same! I much prefer cuddly Gramps!
translation: 我也是！我更喜欢现在这个喜欢抱抱的Gramps！

source: Haha, me too. Now come on, let’s get started for the day!
translation: 哈哈，我也是。好了，快点，我们开始今天的工作吧！

source: Alright! We got a whole bunch of people here again, so there’s a lot of cooking to do!
translation: 好！这里又来了这么多人，所以有很多饭要做！

source: Should we clean up the mess hall first, though? It’s probably a little dustier than usual…
translation: 不过，我们是不是应该先把餐厅打扫干净？这里可能比平时更积灰……

source: Sure thing, Yoshi!
translation: 没问题，Yoshi！

source: Ah, hello, Jin!
translation: 啊，你好，Jin！

source: Hello, you two!
translation: 你们好！

source: What’s up? Did you want some breakfast before work today?
translation: 怎么了？今天上工前想吃点早餐吗？

source: A-Ah, no, no, I actually wanted to show you guys something!
translation: 啊、啊，不，不是的，其实我是想给你们看点东西！

source: Huh? What is it, Jin?
translation: 嗯？是什么，Jin？

source: Well, remember that blog that we’ve been working on for the last couple of months?
translation: 记得我们过去几个月一直在做的那个博客吗？

source: I was able to finish it!
translation: 我把它完成了！

source: Wow! This is really amazing, Jin! It’s so nostalgic to see ourselves on the website like that!
translation: 哇！这真的太棒了，Jin！看到我们这样出现在网站上，真让人怀念！

source: Yeah, this looks like it took a lot of effort to do!
translation: 是啊，这看起来费了很多功夫！

source: Thanks, I’m really proud of it! I can’t wait to see what people say about it.
translation: 谢谢，我真的为它感到骄傲！我迫不及待想看看大家会怎么评价它。

source: Yuri was super excited to see her journal digitized so she can view it anytime she wants.
translation: Yuri特别期待看到自己的日志被数字化，这样她想什么时候看都可以。

source: If you guys want to check it out more and explore each page, I’d be happy to give you guys a soft copy!
translation: 如果你们想再深入看看、浏览每一页，我很乐意给你们一份电子版！

source: Wow, you really went all out on this, Jin… I hope it didn’t mess with your other work!
translation: 哇，你在这上面真的下足了功夫，Jin……我希望没有影响你的其他工作！

source: Not at all! Yoshinori was helping me out this whole time, and it’s more of a side project I did for fun!
translation: 完全没有！这段时间Yoshinori一直在帮我，而且这更像是我出于兴趣做的一个副项目！

source: Oh right! I remember a few times you got me and everybody else to throw a thing or two in there!
translation: 哦，对了！我记得有几次你让我们也往里面加了一两样东西！

source: I guess in a way, this project helped me get to know you all better, and it made me feel like I was part of all the amazing memories you shared.
translation: 我想从某种意义上说，这个项目让我更了解你们，也让我感觉自己成为了你们共同拥有的那些美好回忆的一部分。

source: Working with you guys the last few months, I got to make amazing memories myself with all of you too.
translation: 过去几个月和你们一起工作，我自己也和大家创造了许多美好回忆。

source: Aww, Jin~
translation: 哎呀，Jin～

source: I… I guess that’s another thing that I learned here – how to make friends.
translation: 我……我想这也是我在这里学到的另一件事——学会交朋友。

source: I feel bad about being a shut-in for so long… I can’t help but feel like I’ve missed out on a lot.
translation: 我为自己这么久一直闭门不出感到难过……我总觉得自己错过了很多。

source: I’ve gotten so used to having people around me just come and go, and I always found it easier to not deal with anyone but myself.
translation: 我已经习惯了身边的人来了又走，也总觉得不和别人打交道、只顾自己会更容易。

source: I wish I wasn’t such an introvert...
translation: 我真希望自己不是这么内向……

source: But it’s part of who you are, Jin!
translation: 但这正是你的一部分，Jin！

source: And besides, you pushed yourself out of your comfort zone knowing you’d have to deal with a lot of people when you signed up to work with us.
translation: 而且，你报名和我们一起工作时，明知道要面对很多人，却还是逼自己走出了舒适区。

source: That takes a lotta guts, if you ask me~
translation: 依我看，那可需要很大的勇气～

source: Yeah… I guess I shouldn’t think of it as a bad thing.
translation: 是啊……我想我不该把它当成一件坏事。

source: I-It’s just… I’ve never had a place where I can express who I am and be accepted for the things I thought were bad about myself.
translation: 这、只是……我从来没有一个地方，可以表达真实的自己，并被人接受那些我以为是自己缺点的地方。

source: And to think we only have a few months left ’til the project ends… I’ll be losing the closest thing I have to a ‘social circle’.
translation: 而且想想看，我们只剩几个月项目就要结束了……我将失去自己拥有的最接近“社交圈”的东西。

source: Just the thought of leaving Camp Buddy is so dreadful…
translation: 光是想到要离开 Camp Buddy，我就害怕得不得了……

source: Oh, I totally get you! It’s why I turned down Mr. Clermont’s offer, too.
translation: 哦，我完全懂你！这也是我拒绝Clermont先生邀请的原因。

source: Being a professional chef would be awesome, but I’m where I’m meant to be.
translation: 成为专业厨师当然很棒，但我属于这里。

source: Yeah, I understand that feeling now…
translation: 是啊，我现在明白这种感觉了……

source: Then why don’t you stay here and work with us? Nobody else is good with computers like you are!
translation: 那你为什么不留下来和我们一起工作？没有人比你更擅长电脑了！

source: Wh-What…? L-Like, work here permanently?!
translation: 什、什么……？永、永久留在这里工作？！

source: Aiden, you shouldn’t pressure Jin with stuff like that. Mr. Clermont pays a lot more than we could, I’m sure.
translation: Aiden，你不该用这种事给 Jin 施压。Clermont先生给的钱肯定比我们能给的多。

source: Haha, it’s just if he wants to! I’m just saying it’s a possibility!
translation: 哈哈，只要他自己愿意就好！我只是说这也是一种可能！

source: Umm… I guess someone would probably need to stay to maintain most of the tech…
translation: 嗯……这里大概确实需要有人留下来维护大部分技术……

source: And what better person than the one who installed it!
translation: 而且还有谁会比安装它的人更合适呢？

source: I… might think about it.
translation: 我……可以考虑一下。

source: —Ohh! I have an idea that would get you to stay~
translation: ——哦！我有个办法能让你留下来～

source: If you stick around, we’ll get Yoshi to serve food with me in just an apron every meal!
translation: 如果你留下来，我们就让Yoshi每顿饭都只穿一条围裙，和我一起上菜！

source: W-WAHHH!! What?!!
D-Don’t listen to him, Jin… He’s just messing with you.
translation: 别、别听他的，Jin……他只是在逗你。

source: Oh, come on, Yoshi! Aren’t we trying to poach Jin here?
translation: 拜托，Yoshi！我们不是正在挖 Jin 过来吗？

source: Hngh… Beefcakes everyday…
translation: 唔……每天都有肌肉男……

source: *sigh* Let’s get the food ready before Jin passes out.
translation: *叹气* 趁 Jin 晕倒之前，我们还是先把饭准备好吧。

source: More like that’d make him run dry.
translation: 不如说那会让他彻底干涸。

source: Fwahh, feels good to be back in the kitchen! We got lots of mouths to feed today!
translation: 呜哇，回到厨房的感觉真好！今天有很多张嘴等着吃饭！

source: Haha, yeah! Although I think we left some dirty dishes last night…
translation: 哈哈，是啊！不过我想我们昨晚还留了些脏盘子……

source: Oh drats. Mind doing some washing while I get started prepping?
translation: 哦，糟糕。你介意我开始准备的时候，你先洗一下吗？

source: Sure, I—
translation: 当然，我——

source: Huh? Is somebody else in here?
translation: 嗯？这里还有别人吗？

source: Whoa, Emilia! Why are you washing dishes?
translation: 哇，Emilia！你为什么在洗碗？

source: Would you rather have everyone eat off of dirty plates?
translation: 难道你想让大家用脏盘子吃饭？

source: I’m simply performing my duties as an official member of the maintenance department.
translation: 我只是在履行自己作为维护部门正式成员的职责。

source: Emilia, you really amaze me every day with how much you’ve changed.
translation: Emilia，你改变了这么多，每天都让我惊叹。

source: Yeah, I feel like the old Emilia died and was replaced by an evil doppelganger.
translation: 是啊，我感觉以前的Emilia死了，换成了一个邪恶的分身。

source: Oh, you flatter me too much. Dishwashing isn’t that revolutionary to be so highly credited for.
translation: 哦，你太会夸我了。洗碗没那么革命性，不值得你们这样大肆称赞。

source: I guess accepting compliments wasn’t part of the job description.
translation: 看来接受夸奖并不在工作说明里。

source: Seriously though, It’s the least I could do.
translation: 不过说真的，这也是我最低限度能做的。

source: Ever since Yuri and I became roommates, she’s been giving me a lot of advice.
translation: 自从我和Yuri成为室友后，她一直给我很多建议。

source: I’ve never had anyone as close as that before, so… I really just wanna give off the same energy.
translation: 我以前从没和谁这么亲近过，所以……我真的只是想展现出同样的活力。

source: Who would’ve thought the girls who pulled each other’s hair are besties now?
translation: 谁能想到那两个曾经互相扯头发的女孩现在成了闺蜜？

source: She’s still annoying, don’t get me wrong. But we’re learning to deal with each other better.
translation: 别误会，她还是很烦人。但我们正在学着更好地相处。

source: I guess, I should take the time to thank both of you as well… for having a constant open mind and giving someone like me a second chance.
translation: 我想，我也应该抽时间谢谢你们两个……谢谢你们始终保持开放的心态，愿意给像我这样的人第二次机会。

source: You all helped me to realize I don’t need to let my past dictate my present.
translation: 你们都帮我意识到，我不必让过去决定现在的我。

source: Especially when others have gone through their own pains and struggles similarly, if not worse than my own.
translation: 尤其是因为其他人也经历过自己的痛苦和挣扎，甚至比我的更严重。

source: My actions definitely have consequences and I’m the only one responsible for them.
translation: 我的行为确实会带来后果，而我也是唯一需要为此负责的人。

source: I know I’m nowhere near to making up for them… But it’s better late than never.
translation: 我知道自己离弥补这些还差得很远……但亡羊补牢总比什么都不做好。

source: That’s a good way to look at it, Emilia!
translation: 这确实是看待问题的好方式，Emilia！

source: What matters is that you’ve chosen the right path and are doing the right thing.
translation: 重要的是，你选择了正确的道路，也在做正确的事。

source: Oh, come on, haven’t you already given me that exact same advice multiple times?
translation: 拜托，你不是已经把一模一样的建议给过我好几次了吗？

source: I did something wrong, regardless of my reasons, so I will apologize. We are adults, after all.
translation: 不管我的理由是什么，我做错了就是做错了，所以我会道歉。毕竟，我们都是成年人。

source: That’s Yoshi for ya! He’s hard wired to give advice, so he can’t help it!
translation: 这就是Yoshi嘛！他天生就爱给人建议，所以想停也停不下来！

source: H-Hey!
translation: 喂、喂！

source: Whew! There we go, all done!
translation: 呼！好了，全部完成！

source: Sorry for taking up space in the kitchen. You’re good to start cooking now!
translation: 抱歉占用了厨房的空间。你现在可以开始做饭了！

source: Ugh, looks like I messed up the manicure Yuri gave me. I’ll just ask her to give me another one!
translation: 呃，看起来我把Yuri给我做的美甲弄坏了。我去让她再给我做一套！

source: Tootles~
translation: 回见～

source: Heyy… What’s with that dazed smile, Yoshi?
translation: 嘿……Yoshi，你那副恍惚的笑容是怎么回事？

source: Oh, sorry Aiden! I’m just so overjoyed to see this side of Emilia.
translation: 哦，抱歉，Aiden！看到Emilia这样的一面，我真的太开心了。

source: Tsk, looking at other people like that, you’re gonna make me jealous.
translation: 啧，用那种眼神看别人，你会让我吃醋的。

source: H-Hey! I-It’s not like that!
translation: 喂、喂！不、不是那样！

source: I dunno… She always called you a “special friend” back then.
translation: 我不知道……她以前总叫你“特别的朋友”。

source: Oh, come on, Aiden! When are you ever gonna let that go?
translation: 拜托，Aiden！你到底什么时候才能放下这件事？

source: Eh, I guess there never was a chance. One of you just doesn’t swing that way.
translation: 唉，我想确实没机会。你们两个里有一个就是不喜欢那一套。

source: *sigh* Can’t we get to work already?
translation: *叹气* 我们能不能已经开始工作了？

source: Yup! Let’s get cooking, good looking!
translation: 好！开始做饭吧，美人！

source: {i}Aiden and I worked on a nice to-go lunch for all the workers at the construction site.{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden和我为施工现场的所有工人准备了一顿不错的外带午餐。{/i}

source: {i}Once it was ready, we headed over there to deliver it!{/i}
translation: {i}准备好后，我们就过去送餐了！{/i}

source: Whoa, it’s bustling over here!
translation: 哇，这里真热闹！

source: Yeah, it feels strange after a couple weeks of quiet, haha!
translation: 是啊，安静了几周后，现在感觉真奇怪，哈哈！

source: Oh, there’s Lloyd and Darius! They look busy~
translation: 哦，那里是Lloyd和Darius！他们看起来很忙～

source: Okay, so based on the layout Jin gave us, there should be a satellite dish right over there.
translation: 好，根据 Jin 给我们的布局，那里应该要安装一个卫星天线。

source: I’ll put it up, don’t worry.
translation: 我来把它装上，别担心。

source: Thanks, Dar. I knew I could count on you.
translation: 谢谢你，Dar。我就知道可以靠你。

source: *pats Lloyd on the head*
translation: *拍了拍Lloyd的头*

source: Alright, I’ll go drill the holes for the wires and give the workers their new tasks!
translation: 好，我去给电线钻孔，再给工人们安排新任务！

source: Aren’t you forgetting something?
translation: 你是不是忘了什么？

source: Oh, come on! I’m literally just gonna go over there!
translation: 拜托！我真的只是去那边一下！

source: F-Fine!
translation: 好、好吧！

source: Chuu~
translation: 啾～

source: Good luck, cutie.
translation: 祝你好运，小可爱。

source: Yeah, yeah…
translation: 行了，行了……

source: Well, well, well! It looks like we’ve got a new couple here at camp!
translation: 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀！看来营地里出现了一对新情侣！

source: Ah. Hello.
translation: 啊。你好。

source: Wait... Since when did you and Lloyd start dating?
translation: 等等……你和Lloyd什么时候开始交往的？

source: Since this morning.
translation: 今天早上。

source: Aiden gave me some advice the other day and it paid off.
translation: 前几天Aiden给了我一些建议，结果很有效。

source: All I needed was to ask Lloyd, after all.
translation: 毕竟，我只需要问Lloyd就行了。

source: Well, I guess I shouldn’t be surprised. You two have been just as close as Aiden and I ever since we were scouts.
translation: 嗯，我想自己不该惊讶。你们两个从童军时代起就和我跟Aiden一样亲密。

source: Haha! Way to go making the moves on little Lloyd!
translation: 哈哈！做得好，成功追到小Lloyd！

source: I didn’t expect you guys to be the PDA-type, though.
translation: 我没想到你们会是那种喜欢公开秀恩爱的类型。

source: It’s still new to me to initiate though.
translation: 不过主动迈出这一步对我来说还是很新鲜。

source: Yeah, you’ve never really seemed like that kind of guy since we’ve known you.
translation: 是啊，自从我们认识你以来，你一直不太像那种人。

source: Yes, but I understand communication is needed.
translation: 没错，但我明白沟通是必要的。

source: I hope someday Lloyd and I will be as colorful as you two’s relationship.
translation: 我希望有一天，Lloyd和我的关系也能像你们两个一样多姿多彩。

source: You shouldn’t compare what you and Lloyd have with others, though.
translation: 不过，你不该拿你和Lloyd的关系去和别人比较。

source: We’re all different, so your dynamic with him has its own style!
translation: 我们每个人都不一样，所以你们之间的相处方式也有自己的风格！

source: Oh… I didn’t think of it that way.
translation: 哦……我以前没从这个角度想过。

source: I just see you two as a perfect example of what I want to have as a relationship.
translation: 我只是把你们看作我想拥有的关系的完美范例。

source: But you’re right. I will try to compare less and embrace what we have uniquely.
translation: 但你说得对。我会尽量少比较，珍惜我们之间独有的关系。

source: Once again I learn something new from you.
translation: 我又一次从你身上学到了新东西。

source: We learn something new every day, right~?
translation: 我们每天都会学到新东西，对吧～？

source: Yes. Today I also learned Lloyd really likes being called cute.
translation: 是的。今天我还学到，Lloyd真的很喜欢被叫作可爱。

source: Except I’m the only one allowed to say it.
translation: 不过只有我可以这么叫。

source: Aww, that’s really sweet, Darius!
translation: 哎呀，这真甜，Darius！

source: I am planning on taking Lloyd out on the holidays. We’re going deep in space.
translation: 我打算假期带Lloyd出去玩。我们要深入太空。

source: Oho~ Make him ride on your rocket and see stars!
translation: 哦呵～让他坐上你的火箭去看星星！

source: We’re talking about a planetarium here right…? Just so we’re clear.
translation: 我们说的是天文馆，对吧……？先说清楚。

source: Yes. It’s gonna be a big bang.
translation: 是的。会有一场大爆炸。

source: You know, Yoshi here has never taken me on an actual date! Maybe he could learn a thing or two from you~
translation: 你知道吗，Yoshi还从没带我真正约过会！也许他可以向你学一两招～

source: H-Hey! Aren’t you the one who’s been saying not to compare…?
translation: 喂、喂！刚才不是你说不要比较的吗……？

source: Lemme know how it goes, Darius! I wanna stay up to date with you two!
translation: 告诉我进展，Darius！我想随时了解你们两个的情况！

source: That actually reminds me. How will we stay in touch after the contract ends?
translation: 这倒让我想起一件事。合同结束后，我们要怎么保持联系？

source: It’s sad knowing we’ll have to part ways after this.
translation: 想到这之后我们就要分道扬镳，真让人难过。

source: Oh yeah… you’re right about that…
translation: 哦，对啊……你说得没错……

source: I’m really grateful for all the things you guys and Camp Buddy have done for me.
translation: 我真的很感谢你们和 Camp Buddy 为我做的一切。

source: It’s where I met Lloyd, and coming back here gave me the chance to take things with him to the next level.
translation: 我就是在这里遇见Lloyd的，回到这里也让我有机会和他进一步发展。

source: I hope we get to continue this when we move on to our next job.
translation: 我希望我们换到下一份工作后，也能继续这段关系。

source: H-He just left again…
translation: 他、他又走了……

source: Hahaha! You should be used to it by now!
translation: 哈哈哈！你现在应该已经习惯了！

source: I’m glad Darius and Lloyd finally got their label. They’re a really good match for each other!
translation: 我很高兴Darius和Lloyd终于确定关系了。他们真的很般配！

source: *sigh* I’m gonna miss them when all of this is over, though.
translation: *叹气* 不过这一切结束时，我会想念他们的。

source: Don’t worry! I’m sure we can keep in touch!
translation: 别担心！我相信我们可以保持联系！

source: Says like the worst offender of all of us.
translation: 这话偏偏从我们当中最不爱联系别人的家伙嘴里说出来了。

source: Gah! I’ll be better this time, I swear!
translation: 啊！这次我会做得更好，我发誓！

source: Yeah, yeah! Now come on, we need to distribute these lunches!
translation: 是是是！快点，我们得把这些午餐分发出去！

source: Oh, right!
translation: 哦，对！

source: {i}Aiden and I headed to the kitchen and got started cooking lunch for the workers, then spent the rest of the morning distributing them.{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden和我去了厨房，开始为工人们做午餐，随后用整个上午把午餐分发了出去。{/i}

source: {i}Once all the lunches had been handed out, we went around the camp doing maintenance tasks, and before we knew it, the sun was setting.{/i}
translation: {i}午餐全部发完后，我们绕着营地完成维护工作，不知不觉间，太阳已经开始下山了。{/i}

source: {i}Aiden and I spent the rest of the morning in the kitchen, making lunch for everyone and distributing them to all the workers.{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden和我把上午剩下的时间都用在厨房里，为大家做午餐，再分发给所有工人。{/i}

source: {i}Once we finished distributing the lunches to everyone, Aiden and I headed back to the kitchen to cleanup.{/i}
translation: {i}大家的午餐分发完后，Aiden和我回到厨房收拾。{/i}

source: {i}We then went around the camp doing all the maintenance tasks, and before we knew it, the sun was setting.{/i}
translation: {i}然后我们绕着营地完成所有维护工作，不知不觉间，太阳已经开始下山了。{/i}

source: Whew! A nice hot shower really helped wash off all that sweat!
translation: 呼！洗个热水澡真的把汗都冲掉了！

source: Yeah. It’s nice to take a short break to rest our backs and breathe a little.
translation: 是啊。短暂休息一下，放松腰背、喘口气，感觉真不错。

source: Hehe, don’t get too relaxed, we only have an hour before we have to start prepping for dinner!
translation: 嘿嘿，别放松得太早，我们只有一个小时就得开始准备晚餐了！

source: Of course, of course.
translation: 当然，当然。

source: We’re gonna be crazy busy for the next few months again, huh?
translation: 接下来的几个月我们又要忙得不可开交了，对吧？

source: Yeah, definitely! It’s gonna be a long winter – we’ll be working till all the snow melts outside!
translation: 是啊，绝对的！这会是一个漫长的冬天——外面的雪全部融化之前，我们都要一直工作！

source: I can’t believe that when we started this project months ago, I was worried about not being able to do anything.
translation: 真不敢相信，几个月前项目刚开始时，我还担心自己什么都做不了。

source: Hehe, you got more than what you asked for.
translation: 嘿嘿，你得到的可比你要求的多。

source: Yeah, I couldn’t have been more wrong.
translation: 是啊，我错得不能更离谱了。

source: When I became a scoutmaster here I never stopped grinding, always afraid of screwing something up.
translation: 我在这里成为童军团长后，从没停止努力，总是害怕搞砸什么。

source: For the first time in years, I’m happy that Camp Buddy doesn’t have to deal with the risk of closure or damage control anymore.
translation: 这么多年来第一次，我很高兴 Camp Buddy 不再需要面对关闭或危机处理的风险了。

source: It’s been nice to have some time to actually focus on ourselves, too!
translation: 有时间真正关注我们自己，也感觉很不错！

source: Yeah, plus I wouldn’t have ever been able to deal with all that stuff from my past, so I’m glad.
translation: 是啊，而且如果不是这样，我也永远没法处理过去的那些事，所以我很高兴。

source: Me too, it’s nice to know we both got some closure!
translation: 我也是，知道我们都得到了一些释怀的机会，感觉真好！

source: From here on out, we can really focus on what’s ahead of us.
translation: 从现在开始，我们可以真正专注于前方的道路了。

source: Haha, you could almost say this was a ‘scoutmaster season!’
translation: 哈哈，几乎可以说这是“童军团长季”了！

source: But sheesh… adulting really sucks. I kinda miss how simple our lives were during our first term.
translation: 不过啧……成年人真难当。我有点怀念第一个营期时我们简单的生活。

source: Now, every decision we make has either serious rewards or consequences – back then, everything was just one exciting thing after the next!
translation: 现在，我们做出的每个决定要么带来巨大的回报，要么带来严重的后果——那时候，一切只是一个接一个的兴奋体验！

source: All we ever worried about was getting caught, stupid crushes, or promises we didn’t fully understand.
translation: 我们唯一担心的就是被抓到、愚蠢的暗恋，或者那些我们还没完全理解的承诺。

source: I guess that’s why I’m so passionate about being a scoutmaster… it’s like I get to relive those memories through the scouts.
translation: 我想这就是我如此热爱担任童军团长的原因……我可以通过童军们重新体验那些回忆。

source: Well, with twice as many enrollees, let’s see if you can handle all that ‘youthful energy’ haha!
translation: 既然报名人数翻了一倍，那就看看你能不能应付那些“青春活力”，哈哈！

source: After this off season, I’m ready to get back to it! I can’t wait to teach the scouts again!
translation: 休营期结束后，我已经准备好回去了！我等不及要再次教导童军们！

source: Then let’s make sure that they have the best Camp Buddy to come back to!
translation: 那我们一定要确保他们回来时，能看到最棒的 Camp Buddy！

source: With this, Aiden started having much more time for himself, and he used it to make our meals at camp much more special.
translation: 从那以后，Aiden有了更多属于自己的时间，他用这些时间让营地里的每顿饭都变得特别起来。

source: I could tell that the opportunity he was offered made him more inspired and determined to try out new things!
translation: 我看得出来，他得到的机会让自己更有灵感，也更坚定地尝试新事物！

source: Even with all the work, we still managed to sneak in another party for the holidays!
translation: 即使工作繁忙，我们还是设法在假期又举办了一场聚会！

source: And of all people, Yuri even suggested that we drink together! We all laughed and talked as we reminisced about old times!
translation: 而且在所有人当中，Yuri竟然还提议我们一起喝酒！我们一边回忆往事，一边笑着聊天！

source: We all felt like we were back at our very first term at Camp Buddy, and I wouldn’t have changed it for anything!
translation: 我们都有一种回到 Camp Buddy 第一个营期的感觉，而我什么都不愿改变！

source: Of course, this celebration wouldn’t be complete without a reward for everyone’s hard work.
translation: 当然，这次庆祝活动如果没有奖励大家辛苦工作的环节，就不完整了。

source: Our wonderfully talented chef, Aiden, has prepared a reception party for our success!
translation: 我们才华横溢的厨师Aiden，为庆祝成功准备了一场宴会！

source: Let’s use the last of our time together as a team to remember the good memories and hard work on this project!
translation: 让我们利用作为团队共处的最后时光，回忆这个项目中的美好记忆和辛勤工作吧！

source: This is a truly momentous day, so eat your hearts out, and celebrate these final moments with each other!
translation: 今天是一个真正值得纪念的日子，所以尽情享用美食，和彼此一起庆祝最后的时刻吧！

source: *cheering*
translation: *欢呼*

source: Phew, I think that was the final order!
translation: 呼，我想那是最后一份订单了！

source: Thanks for waiting on the tables, Yoshi! How did everyone like the food?
translation: 谢谢你帮忙招待大家，Yoshi！大家喜欢这些食物吗？

source: Oh, they loved it! If you didn’t notice, it started getting quiet out there, everyone’s so busy munching down on your food, haha!
translation: 哦，他们喜欢极了！你没发现吗，外面已经安静下来了，大家都忙着大口吃你的料理，哈哈！

source: Aww, I wish I got to see their reactions!
translation: 哎呀，我真希望能看到他们的反应！

source: W-Well, you could have if you had at least worn pants…
translation: 这、这个嘛，如果你至少穿条裤子，本来就能看到了……

source: No way! The snow finally melted, and I actually missed going commando in my kitchen!
translation: 才不要！雪终于融化了，我其实很怀念在厨房里不穿内裤的感觉！

source: You should know by now that’s my special secret to good cooking~!
translation: 你现在应该知道了，那是我做出美味料理的特别秘诀～！

source: I know, I know. But we don’t want people choking on their food on the last day, right?
translation: 我知道，我知道。但我们可不想让大家在最后一天吃东西时被噎到，对吧？

source: Oh come on, Yoshi! I’m sure everyone’d like to have my cakes for dessert!
translation: 拜托，Yoshi！我相信大家都想拿我的蛋糕当甜点！

source: Okay, I totally saw that coming. Except I thought you’d also make a pun out of choking.
translation: 好吧，我完全猜到了。不过我还以为你会再拿噎到开个玩笑。

source: Well then—
translation: 那么——

source: *gropes Aiden’s butt*
translation: *摸了摸Aiden的屁股*

source: I’ve been wanting to get my hands on you all morning…
translation: 我整个上午都想对你动手动脚了……

source: Oho~ Now all of a sudden you don’t care that anyone can just walk in and see us?
translation: 哦呵～突然之间，你就不在乎有人走进来看到我们了？

source: It’s been a while – we’ve been so busy with work, there hasn’t been time.
translation: 已经有一阵子了——我们一直忙于工作，根本没时间。

source: And now that we’re finished with everything, I feel like I could use a serious release…
translation: 现在一切都完成了，我觉得自己需要来一场彻底的释放……

source: Haha, it figures you’d get turned on from finishing a project!
translation: 哈哈，完成项目居然会让你兴奋起来，真是意料之中！

source: H-Hey, that’s not it! And I thought you liked it when I made the first move!
translation: 喂、喂！才不是因为那个！我还以为你喜欢我主动呢！

source: And how can I help it? Seeing you in only an apron is one of my favorite looks.
translation: 我能怎么办？你只穿围裙的样子是我最喜欢的装扮之一。

source: Hehe~ Where was this pervy Yoshi at all this time?
translation: 嘿嘿～这个好色的Yoshi到底躲到哪里去了？

source: Alright, alright~ But I’d rather you take your time~
translation: 好啦，好啦～但我更希望你慢慢来～

source: KYAAAAAA!!
translation: 呀啊啊啊啊！！

source: GAHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

source: Oh no! A-Aiden, put something on…!
translation: 糟了！艾、Aiden，穿点衣服……！

source: It’s been nearly a decade, and now I finally get to witness this most awaited moment with my own two eyes~!
translation: 快十年了，我终于能亲眼见证这个期待已久的时刻了～！

source: To think Yoshi’s baking his hotdog in Aiden’s lovin’ oven while all of us were having a meal outside!
translation: 谁能想到Yoshi在我们所有人都在外面吃饭的时候，正在Aiden的爱之烤箱里烤他的热狗！

source: Th-there so much ‘cream’ all over the kitchen…
translation: 到、到处都是‘奶油’……

source: My goodness, Yuri! NO!
translation: 我的天啊，Yuri！不可以！

source: *gulp* M-My mouth’s watering… I want some too…
translation: *咽口水* 我、我的嘴都要流口水了……我也想吃……

source: Well, why don’t we give you a huge serving then?
translation: 那我们为什么不给你来一大份呢？

source: Think you can take us both…? Hmmm~?
translation: 你觉得自己能同时承受我们两个吗……？嗯嗯～？

source: A-Aiden!!!
translation: 艾、Aiden！！！

source: GHUHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
translation: 呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

source: Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!!!!! AAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!!!!!!
translation: 呀啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

source: I heard screams, what’s going—
translation: 我听见尖叫了，发生什么——

source: Oh.
translation: 哦。

source: Nope. I’m out.
translation: 不行。我走了。

source: Wow… Daring…
translation: 哇……大胆……

source: What the hell!? I thought my meal was vegetarian?!
translation: 搞什么鬼！？我还以为我的饭是素食的？！

source: *sigh* Haven’t I warned you both about this before? Yuri easily passes out and Jin might lose too much blood.
translation: *叹气* 我之前不是警告过你们两个别再这样吗？Yuri很容易晕倒，Jin 也可能失血过多。

source: Hehe, sorry, Gramps! We got carried away…
translation: 嘿嘿，抱歉，Gramps！我们一时兴奋过头了……

source: W-We’ll clean up right away. I’m so sorry, sir!
translation: 我、我们马上就收拾干净。真的很抱歉，先生！

source: *ehem* It’s alright, just uh… don’t let anyone else see next time.
translation: *咳咳* 没关系，只是呃……下次别让别人再看到了。

source: You should try that position, Lloyd.
translation: 你应该试试那个姿势，Lloyd。

source: Easy~ Did you forget how flexible I am?
translation: 简单～你忘了我有多灵活吗？

source: Not now, you two. Help me carry Yuri and Jin out.
translation: 现在不是时候，你们两个。帮我把Yuri和 Jin 抬出去。

source: Oh god… that was so embarrassing, Aiden…  Everybody saw you covered in… you know.
translation: 天啊……那真是太丢人了，Aiden……大家都看见你被……你知道的，弄得全身都是。

source: What’s new~? Everybody knows we’re together anyway and besides, it looked like they were enjoying the show!
translation: 有什么新鲜的～？反正大家都知道我们在一起，而且看起来他们还很享受这场表演！

source: I think it’s kinda funny to get caught~
translation: 我觉得被抓到还挺好笑的～

source: You really are an exhibitionist, Aiden…
translation: 你真是个暴露狂，Aiden……

source: With a sexy bod like this? Why wouldn’t I want to show it off~?
translation: 有这么性感的身材？我为什么不想展示一下～？

source: *sigh* I guess.
translation: *叹气* 我想也是。

source: Now let’s go join them! All that boning made me hungry!
translation: 现在我们去加入他们吧！刚才做了那么多爱，我饿了！

source: You haven’t even cleaned up yet! Or gotten dressed!
translation: 你甚至还没收拾干净！也还没穿衣服！

source: Aww, do I have to?
translation: 哎呀，我非得穿吗？

source: Yes! Come on, I’ll wash you off!
translation: 当然！快来，我帮你洗干净！

source: Ahh, it’s so nice to be enjoying your cooking again, Aiden!
translation: 啊，能再次享用你做的饭真好，Aiden！

source: I believe I could eat your meals every day and be quite happy!
translation: 我觉得每天吃你做的饭都会很开心！

source: Aww thanks~ The secret ingredient is ‘love.’
translation: 哎呀谢谢～秘密配料是‘爱’。

source: Yes, we all saw just exactly what that ‘love’ entails.
translation: 是啊，我们刚才已经亲眼见识了这份‘爱’到底是什么。

source: Hnghh!
translation: 呃啊！

source: Be careful or Yuri and Jin might need to see a doctor.
translation: 小心点，不然Yuri和 Jin 可能需要去看医生。

source: Haha, it’s always fun to watch them gush about this stuff though! Dar and I have learned to trigger them too~
translation: 哈哈，不过看他们为这种事激动起来总是很有趣！Dar和我也学会怎么逗他们了～

source: See, Lloyd understands! I always love poking at these two~!
translation: 看，Lloyd懂我！我总喜欢逗这两个人～！

source: *ehem* Behave, all of you.
translation: *咳咳* 你们都规矩点。

source: Haha, I’ll have to start making more regular trips here to join in on the fun!
translation: 哈哈，我得开始更经常来这里，加入你们的乐趣了！

source: It’s a totally different world from my usual work! Everything is always bright and full of laughter! Not to mention the good food!
translation: 这和我平时的工作完全是两个世界！这里总是充满阳光和笑声！更不用说还有美食！

source: You’re always welcome here, sir! And I’ll be sure to cook you something nice every time~
translation: 先生，您随时欢迎！我每次都会做些好吃的给您～

source: You’re tempting me to put on some weight with an offer like that, Aiden, hahaha!
translation: 你这么说可是在诱惑我长胖啊，Aiden，哈哈哈！

source: Yoshinori, are you alright? It’s been a while since I saw you so lost in your thoughts.
translation: Yoshinori，你还好吗？我已经有一阵子没见你这样陷入沉思了。

source: O-Oh! I was just thinking about how surreal everything is… the project is done, and Camp Buddy is two times bigger than it was.
translation: 哦、哦！我只是在想，一切都太不真实了……项目完成了，而 Camp Buddy 也变成了原来的两倍大。

source: Yeah, I feel like I’m having withdrawals already – after so much work the last few months, I feel like I should be working still…
translation: 是啊，我感觉自己已经开始戒断了——过去几个月工作太多，我觉得自己现在还应该继续工作……

source: But we managed to get everything done! We’ve all earned this break!
translation: 但我们把一切都完成了！这段休息是我们应得的！

source: It’s bittersweet too, though… Everyone’s going to be leaving soon.
translation: 不过这感觉也很苦乐参半……大家很快就要离开了。

source: *sigh* I know that we’ve done a good job and all, but I’m really gonna miss working with you guys…
translation: *叹气* 我知道我们做得很好什么的，但我真的会想念和你们一起工作……

source: Uh-oh, here come the waterworks.
translation: 糟糕，眼泪要来了。

source: Having you all here has been one of the best times I’ve had working here!
translation: 有你们在这里，是我在这里工作时最美好的时光之一！

source: It’s really going to be different without you guys…
translation: 没有你们，真的会完全不一样……

source: Wh-What…? Did I say something?
translation: 什、什么……？我说了什么吗？

source: Go on, tell the poor fool, he’s close to tears.
translation: 继续说啊，告诉这个可怜的傻瓜，他都快哭了。

source: T-Tell me what?
translation: 告、告诉我什么？

source: Well… Me and the others have been talking…
translation: 嗯……我和其他人商量过了……

source: We all decided that we want to stay here at Camp Buddy if that’s alright...?
translation: 我们都决定，如果可以的话，想留在 Camp Buddy……？

source: Wh-What?!
translation: 什、什么？！

source: W-Woah?! REALLY?! That’s so cool!
translation: 哇、哇？！真的？！太棒了！

source: Yeah! We loved it here so much we don’t wanna leave anymore!
translation: 是啊！我们太喜欢这里了，已经不想离开了！

source: We’re ready for a change of pace from all the construction work.
translation: 我们想换个节奏，不再一直做施工工作。

source: W-Wait, a-are you all sure?!
translation: 等、等等，你们确定吗？！

source: What? You don’t want them to stay?! Isn’t this what you’ve been tearing up about for the past two minutes?
translation: 什么？你不想让他们留下？！这不就是你过去两分钟一直哭的原因吗？

source: N-No, I mean…
translation: 不、不是，我的意思是……

source: Well, we all thought about it over the last few months, after we realized that staying was a possibility.
translation: 过去几个月里，我们意识到留下是个可能后，就都认真考虑过了。

source: They actually coordinated it already with Mr. Clermont, and he agreed as well.
translation: 其实他们已经和Clermont先生协调过了，他也同意了。

source: Yuri? You were in on this?
translation: Yuri？你也参与其中？

source: We thought it would be nice to leave it as a surprise for you, Aiden, and Dad.
translation: 我们觉得把这个惊喜留给你、Aiden和爸爸会很不错。

source: B-But… Wh-Why? Don’t you guys all have great career opportunities ahead of you?
translation: 但、但是……为、为什么？你们不是都有很好的职业机会吗？

source: I have a lot of extra income online, not to mention my crypto… So, it doesn’t really matter for me…
translation: 我在网上有很多额外收入，更不用说我的加密货币了……所以对我来说其实没什么影响……

source: And… seeing how everyone here was part of Camp Buddy in the past, I feel I missed a part of my youth.
translation: 而且……看到这里的每个人过去都曾是 Camp Buddy 的一员，我觉得自己错过了青春的一部分。

source: I want to experience being a scout and taking part in the activities too!
translation: 我想体验成为童军、参加活动的感觉！

source: More importantly, someone needs to maintain the new tech and even do some upgrades down the line.
translation: 更重要的是，需要有人维护新技术，甚至在以后进行升级。

source: It’d be much easier for everyone to have an in-house technician, right? I’d say that’s a win-win!
translation: 有一名内部技术员，对所有人来说都会轻松得多，对吧？我觉得这是双赢！

source: Yiieee! My fanfic buddy is staying!
translation: 咿耶！我的同人文伙伴要留下来！

source: Dar and I plan to apply as scoutmasters, so you don’t have to worry about us either!
translation: Dar和我打算申请成为童军团长，所以你也不用担心我们！

source: We both really enjoyed teaching Taiga and Yoichi over the project, and want to share our knowledge with the rest of the scouts.
translation: 在项目期间，我们都很喜欢教导Taiga和Yoichi，也想把我们的知识分享给其他童军。

source: Plus, Aiden’s cooking is worth staying for.
translation: 而且，光是为了Aiden做的饭也值得留下。

source: As for the financial part, we have a plan for it as well!
translation: 至于经济方面，我们也有计划！

source: While we’re here, we’ll be running a nice side hustle – a design consultancy firm!
translation: 我们会留在这里，同时经营一份不错的副业——设计顾问公司！

source: We call it D-L-Do! “Darius and Lloyd will do it all for you~”
translation: 我们叫它 D-L-Do！“Darius和Lloyd为你包办一切～”

source: We’ve been in the industry for years already as contractors… it’s about time we started our own firm.
translation: 我们作为承包商已经在这个行业工作多年……现在也该成立自己的公司了。

source: With Lloyd and I working together, we thought it would be the perfect opportunity to make this decision.
translation: Lloyd和我一起工作，我们觉得现在正是做出这个决定的好时机。

source: It was actually all quite impressive – they laid out not only their personal plans but also ideas for the camp as well.
translation: 其实这一切都令人印象深刻——他们不仅制定了个人计划，也提出了营地方面的想法。

source: Lloyd and Darius came up with a woodworking and construction curriculum for your scouts, and they’re quite passionate about it!
translation: Lloyd和Darius为你们的童军设计了木工和建筑课程，他们对此非常有热情！

source: Personally, I’d love to see them all join the camp, but it’s up to the president’s final say!
translation: 就我个人而言，我很希望看到他们加入营地，但最终还是要由营地负责人决定！

source: Y-Yeah… We decided this on our own, and we don’t really want to force it if it’s not—
translation: 是、是啊……这是我们自己做的决定，如果不行的话，我们也不想强——

source: I have no objections – I would be honored to have all these talented and dedicated people as scoutmasters!
translation: 我没有异议——能让这些才华横溢又尽职尽责的人担任童军团长，是我的荣幸！

source: Haha, I knew you’d approve them right away.
translation: 哈哈，我就知道你会马上同意他们。

source: Awesome! We got the job, Dar!
translation: 太棒了！我们拿到工作了，Dar！

source: Hooray.
translation: 万岁。

source: As for me, I’m going to stick with the helper role.
translation: 至于我，我会继续担任助手。

source: Eh…? You’re not gunning to be a scoutmaster too?
translation: 诶……？你不打算也成为童军团长吗？

source: No… I noticed during my time as both an inspector and these last few months that Aiden does all the maintenance work by himself, both during the on and off season.
translation: 不……我在担任检查员以及过去几个月的工作期间注意到，无论营期内外，维护工作一直都是Aiden一个人完成的。

source: I… want to help alleviate some of his workload so he can focus more on what he’s really passionate about, cooking.
translation: 我……想帮他减轻一些工作量，让他能更多地专注于自己真正热爱的烹饪。

source: Plus, doing chores over the last few months has been strangely… enjoyable.
translation: 而且，过去几个月做家务竟然……挺让人愉快的。

source: I never experienced them growing up, and always was disgusted by ‘dirty work.’
translation: 我从小就没体验过这些，还一直厌恶所谓的‘脏活’。

source: Now, I feel a real sense of fulfilment when I complete them, seeing everyone enjoy the comfort as a direct result of my hard work.
translation: 现在，看到大家因为我的努力直接享受到舒适，我完成这些事时真的会感到满足。

source: Not to mention that I’m learning new skills as well.
translation: 更不用说，我还学会了新技能。

source: That’s great, Emilia! You’ve got such a wonderful mindset about it all now!
translation: 太好了，Emilia！你现在看待这一切的心态真棒！

source: Hihi, with all this extra help, I can also focus more on being a counselor for the scouts that need it!
translation: 嘻嘻，有了这些额外的帮助，我也可以更专心地担任需要帮助的童军的辅导员了！

source: E-Everyone… You don’t know how happy this makes me…
translation: 大、大家……你们不知道这让我有多开心……

source: Oh no! Here come the waterworks for real!
translation: 糟糕！这次眼泪真的要出来了！

source: I-I can’t help it… you guys…
translation: 我、我控制不住……你们……

source: Let it all out, Yoshinori.
translation: 尽情哭出来吧，Yoshinori。

source: O-Oh! Since everyone is here, I think this is the perfect time for us to take a victory selfie!
translation: 哦、哦！既然大家都在，我觉得现在正适合拍一张胜利自拍！

source: Oooooh~! Good idea! I think we could also add it to our website!
translation: 哦哦哦～！好主意！我觉得还可以把它加到网站上！

source: Definitely! I was already planning to make the expansion project my next feature on there!
translation: 当然！我本来就打算把扩建项目作为下一个专题放上去！

source: I’ll setup the camera! Everyone, huddle up!
translation: 我来设置相机！大家靠拢！

source: And… the timer is set!
translation: 而且……计时器设好了！

source: Everybody say, ‘Camp Buddy!’
translation: 大家一起说：“Camp Buddy！”

source: Camp Buddy!
translation: Camp Buddy！

source: Seasons have come and gone since we started this amazing project… And everything that happened was the opposite of what I thought it’d be.
translation: 自从我们开始这个惊人的项目以来，季节更迭……而发生的一切都和我原本想象的相反。

source: It was quite the ride – we encountered problems that couldn’t be predicted from when we were scouts, or even from before we returned to camp.
translation: 这是一段跌宕起伏的旅程——我们遇到了童军时期、甚至回到营地之前都无法预料的问题。

source: Things didn’t always work out the way we planned, and we were challenged way past our limits.
translation: 事情并不总是按计划发展，我们面临的挑战远远超出了极限。

source: And in these darkest moments, Aiden’s best trait really shined – his perseverance. It was the reason why I could move forward too.
translation: 而在这些最黑暗的时刻，Aiden最优秀的特质真正闪耀了——他的坚持。这也是我能继续前进的原因。

source: I am so grateful we had the chance to continue where our stories left off… and it helped me learn even more about him and his past.
translation: 我非常感激我们有机会续写各自中断的故事……这也帮助我进一步了解了他和他的过去。

source: I know now where his happiness and pain comes from, and from this, we were able to make our new promise to each other.
translation: 我现在明白他的幸福和痛苦源自何处，也正因此，我们得以彼此许下新的承诺。

source: And I owe it all to Camp Buddy… That’s why we’re going to give it everything we’ve got and face the future with the brightest smile.
translation: 这一切都要归功于 Camp Buddy……所以我们会竭尽全力，让脸上带着最灿烂的笑容面对未来。

source: Forever, it’s our buddy oath!
translation: 永远如此，这就是我们的伙伴誓言！

source: Ah, it’s so nice to see this new part of our camp in full bloom. I feel like a proud mother seeing all my plants grow so prettily~
translation: 啊，看到营地这一崭新区域百花齐放真好。我感觉自己就像一位骄傲的母亲，看着所有植物如此漂亮地成长～

source: Hey, I’m not letting you take all the credit! They’re my babies too!
translation: 嘿，我可不会让你把功劳全抢走！它们也是我的宝贝！

source: *ehem* You both seem to be forgetting it was Aiden who taught you both gardening.
translation: *咳咳* 你们两个是不是忘了，是Aiden教会你们园艺的。

source: You’re just jealous ’cause you’ve literally been a bum since the project was over, Dad!
translation: 你只是嫉妒，因为项目结束后你一直就是个闲人，爸爸！

source: I’d try and argue with you, but you’re right.
translation: 我本来想和你争辩，但你说得对。

source: It’s so hard to believe that we’ve been doing absolutely nothing for the past few weeks… considering how full our hands were for over half a year.
translation: 真难以相信，考虑到半年多以来我们一直忙得不可开交，过去几周我们居然什么都没做……

source: Yeah… I don’t think I’ll ever get used to being this laid back.
translation: 是啊……我想自己永远都不会习惯这么悠闲。

source: Come on you two! Learn to relax, we deserve it after all!
translation: 好了，你们两个！学着放松，我们应得的！

source: Yeah… I know. The only thing left to do is to wait for the scouts.
translation: 是啊……我知道。现在唯一要做的就是等童军们回来。

source: Summer is right around the corner, though. The scouts will be coming back soon.
translation: 不过夏天就在眼前了。童军们很快就会回来。

source: Yeah, I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when they see how big the camp is now!
translation: 是啊，我等不及想看他们看到营地现在这么大时脸上的表情了！

source: We should give them a tour on the first day, don’t you think? I think they’d really love that!
translation: 我们应该在第一天带他们参观，你们觉得呢？我想他们一定会很喜欢！

source: Maybe we should leave the activities for Yoshinori to take care of, since it’s what he does best.
translation: 也许应该把活动留给Yoshinori负责，毕竟这是他最擅长的事。

source: He does always come up with ways to make them fun for everyone.
translation: 他总是能想出让大家开心的方法。

source: Like what? Arts and crafts?
translation: 比如艺术和手工？

source: That’s way better than a flopped obstacle course reveal, if you ask me~!
translation: 依我看，这可比一个失败的障碍赛揭幕好多了～！

source: Honestly, I’m eager to meet the scouts. I’ll definitely give them a proper introduction.
translation: 说真的，我很期待见到童军们。我一定会好好向他们介绍自己。

source: But they’d better not get on my bad side.
translation: 但他们最好别惹我生气。

source: Ohhh… Is Emilia gonna be our disciplinary committee?
translation: 哦哦……Emilia要成为我们的纪律委员会吗？

source: I’d like to take you up on that offer. I’m getting too old for this.
translation: 我很乐意接受你的提议。我已经老得不适合做这些了。

source: Oh, speaking of which… looks like some people really can’t wait for summer.
translation: 哦，说到这个……看来有些人真的等不及夏天了。

source: Attention! Straighten your back!
translation: 注意！挺直腰背！

source: You! Stop being all limp!
translation: 你！别这么软绵绵的！

source: Wh-What…? This is my normal posture, Lloyd…
translation: 什、什么……？这就是我平时的姿势，Lloyd……

source: That’s SCOUTGRANDMASTER LLOYD to you!
translation: 要叫我“童军总团长LLOYD”！

source: From now on, you’ll do yoga two hours every morning to fix your posture!
translation: 从现在起，每天早上做两小时瑜伽，纠正你的姿势！

source: Aren’t you being too harsh?
translation: 你是不是太严厉了？

source: Sorry I can’t hear your orders from up here, Pipsqueak!
translation: 抱歉，我听不见你从上面下达的命令，Pipsqueak！

source: Grow five inches taller and then maybe I’ll listen.
translation: 等你长高五英寸再说，也许我就会听你的。

source: HEY! That’s not how these things work!
translation: 喂！事情不是这么办的！

source: True. It’s too late for you to grow.
translation: 没错。你已经来不及长高了。

source: *EHEM* Lucky for you two, I’m a professional, so I’ll let that slide!
translation: *咳咳* 你们两个算走运，我是专业人士，所以这次就算了！

source: So… What’s next?
translation: 那么……接下来是什么？

source: Camping.
translation: 露营。

source: Right, camping! Let’s make a fire out of these two sticks!
translation: 对，露营！让我们用这两根棍子生火吧！

source: I’m starting to regret this decision…
translation: 我开始后悔这个决定了……

source: I’m out. I have dogs to feed.
translation: 我不干了。我还要喂狗。

source: Hell no! You’re not ditching, and leaving me to play house with these dorks!
translation: 想都别想！你不能临阵脱逃，留下我和这些笨蛋过家家！

source: Besides, it’d be really good training for them to deal with the wildest pinhead in the camp!
translation: 再说了，让他们和营地里最野蛮的小笨蛋打交道，对他们来说正是很好的训练！

source: Who you calling pinhead?
translation: 你叫谁小笨蛋呢？

source: If you two join, I’ll give you a treat. Heard you like burgers and mallows.
translation: 你们两个加入的话，我就给你们奖励。听说你们喜欢汉堡和棉花糖。

source: Ugh, fine.
translation: 呃，好吧。

source: Alright! March! Three two one! Three two one!
translation: 好！齐步走！三、二、一！三、二、一！

source: It’s supposed to be the other way around…
translation: 顺序应该反过来才对……

source: Shh…
I guess… they’re getting the hang of it…
translation: 我想……他们开始掌握窍门了……

source: Haha, give them some time. It takes some getting used to.
translation: 哈哈，给他们一点时间。习惯这种事需要过程。

source: Hehe, I remember my first time leading the scouts… I was just as clueless as they were.
translation: 嘿嘿，我还记得自己第一次带领童军时……我和他们一样不知所措。

source: I usually let Yoshi handle most of that stuff!
translation: 通常这种事我都让Yoshi来处理！

source: Speaking of Yoshi… When are he and Aiden going to be back?
translation: 说到Yoshi……他和Aiden什么时候回来？

source: Give them a break, Emilia! Let them enjoy their special honeymoon!
translation: 放他们一马吧，Emilia！让他们享受特别的蜜月吧！

source: How come those two are allowed to go on dates and we’re not?!
translation: 为什么他们两个可以约会，我们却不行？！

source: I don’t remember forbidding it.
translation: 我不记得自己禁止过啊。

source: What?! So, you’re telling me I could’ve been out on a vacation instead of digging up soil and weeding for weeks?!
translation: 什么？！你的意思是，相比挖土除草几周，我本来可以出去度假吗？！

source: Well, you didn’t ask.
translation: 嗯，你又没问。

source: Don’t act like you didn’t enjoy being here with us, Emilia! You were always the first one up doing all the chores!
translation: 别装得好像你不喜欢和我们待在这里，Emilia！每次做家务你都是第一个起床的人！

source: It’s because I thought there was nothing else to do! I’ve been scammed!
translation: 那是因为我以为没别的事可做！我被骗了！

source: Now you know what it feels like.
translation: 现在你知道那是什么感觉了。

source: Honestly, I’m glad those two spent some time together before we get busy again for the next term.
translation: 老实说，我很高兴他们两个在我们下个营期再次忙起来之前，能一起度过一些时间。

source: I know right? It’s a really nice vacation do-over for Aiden!
translation: 我懂吧？这对Aiden来说真是一次很棒的补偿假期！

source: Yoshinori had been planning this surprise date for a while now. It’s actually adorable to see those two so madly in love.
translation: Yoshinori已经计划这次惊喜约会有一阵子了。看着他们两个如此疯狂地相爱，真可爱。

source: Now you get what I feel, Dad?!
translation: 现在你明白我的感受了吧，爸爸？！

source: Hey, don’t change the subject! We need to go on a vacation too!
translation: 嘿，别转移话题！我们也需要去度假！

source: If it helps, they texted me that they’re already on their way back.
translation: 如果这能帮上忙，他们发消息告诉我已经在回来的路上了。

source: If that’s the case then pack your bags, Yuri! We’re going to see that new ‘JS’ movie!
translation: 既然这样就收拾行李吧，Yuri！我们去看那部新出的《JS》电影！

source: KYAAAA! YES, YES! Count me in!
translation: 呀啊啊！好，好！算我一个！

source: Ahh… It’s good to be back!
translation: 啊……回来的感觉真好！

source: We’ve only been gone for a couple days, but I missed Camp Buddy already.
translation: 我们才离开几天，但我已经开始想念 Camp Buddy 了。

source: Me too! But I gotta say, going on a vacation with you was really fun too!
translation: 我也是！不过得说，和你一起度假也真的很有趣！

source: I’m glad you enjoyed it, Aiden! I did promise you I’d take you on an actual date once everything settled down.
translation: 我很高兴你玩得开心，Aiden！我答应过一切稳定下来后带你真正约一次会。

source: And today marks exactly six months since we started dating.
translation: 而今天正好是我们开始交往六个月。

source: You kept count?!
translation: 你还记着时间？！

source: Of course! It’s really special to me.
translation: 当然！这对我来说很特别。

source: Aww that’s really sweet, Yoshi! You’re special to me tooooo~
translation: 哎呀，Yoshi，你真贴心！你对我来说也很特别～～～

source: But now that we’ve had our fun, it’s time for us to get back to work!
translation: 不过既然我们已经玩得尽兴，是时候回去工作了！

source: Yeah! The next term is only a few days away and the scouts are finally gonna see everything we worked hard on.
translation: 是啊！下个营期只有几天就要开始了，童军们终于要看到我们辛苦完成的一切了。

source: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when they do! And of course, when they try my new and improved menu!
translation: 我等不及想看他们看到这些时脸上的表情了！当然，还有他们尝试我改良后的新菜单时的表情！

source: Me too, Aiden!
translation: 我也是，Aiden！

source: Let’s go in, then? I’m sure everybody’s waiting for us too!
translation: 那我们进去吧？我相信大家也都在等我们！

source: Yeah! We’re finally home!
translation: 是啊！我们终于回家了！

source: Speaking of Yoshi… Where is he?! I haven’t seen him today.
translation: 说到Yoshi……他在哪里？！我今天都没见到他。

source: Oh, yeah, he and Aiden are both gone. Hihi, are they sneaking around again?
translation: 哦，对啊，他和Aiden都不在。嘻嘻，他们是不是又偷偷溜出去约会了？

source: Yoshinori actually requested a day off for both of them, since we don’t have anything going on.
translation: Yoshinori其实替他们两个都请了一天假，因为我们现在没什么事要做。

source: He mentioned that since the hotel trip wasn’t relaxing for Aiden, he wanted to make up for it.
translation: 他说酒店之旅没有让Aiden放松，所以想补偿他。

source: Ohhh~ They went on a little date then, huh?
translation: 哦哦～所以他们去约了个小会，是吧？

source: I guess that’s the best thing to do with so much free time. Why don’t we go somewhere too?!
translation: 我想，有这么多空闲时间，最好的选择就是这样。我们为什么不也去什么地方？！

source: Yeah… I’d kill to be in a nice, air-conditioned establishment too…
translation: 是啊……我真想待在一个舒适的空调场所里……

source: Ooooh! How about we go to the movies?! I heard there’s some new one called ‘JS’ out today~
translation: 哦哦哦！我们去看电影怎么样？！我听说今天有一部叫《JS》的新电影上映～

source: Sure, I think I’ve finished all the chores for the day. Turns out they aren’t so bad when nobody is around.
translation: 好啊，我想我今天的家务都做完了。原来没人管的时候，这些活也没那么糟。

source: I’ll go get my coat! Yipeee~
translation: 我去拿外套！耶～～

source: W-Wait, Sir Goro didn’t even say yes yet…!
translation: 等、等等，Goro先生还没说同意呢……！

source: It’s alright Emilia, you girls go ahead. I’ll take charge here.
translation: 没关系，Emilia，你们女孩子去吧。我来负责这里。

source: There’s your yes, Emilia! Thanks, Dad~!
translation: 这不就是同意了吗，Emilia！谢谢你，爸爸～！

source: Fwahhh! Now this is the life!
translation: 呜哇！这才叫生活！

source: Say… What made you decide on this trip all of a sudden?
translation: 话说……你怎么突然决定去这趟旅行？

source: Well… I promised you that I’d take you on an actual date once everything settled down, remember?
translation: 嗯……我答应过一切稳定下来后带你真正约一次会，记得吗？

source: Wow, I already forgot about that, hahaha!
translation: 哇，我已经忘了，哈哈哈！

source: And, today is also exactly six months since we started dating.
translation: 而且，今天正好是我们开始交往六个月。

source: Of course. It’s really special to me.
translation: 当然。这对我来说很特别。

source: I wish I had a surprise for you, but you really caught me off guard when you said we were going out today.
translation: 我本来想给你一个惊喜，但你今天说要出门，真的让我措手不及。

source: I was surprised when you woke me up this morning and our bags were already packed, and all you’d say was that we were driving somewhere!
translation: 今天早上你叫醒我的时候，我很惊讶行李已经收拾好了，而且你只说我们要开车去某个地方！

source: Well, I’ve been planning this for a while now, so I’m glad everything went smoothly!
translation: 嗯，我已经计划这件事有一阵子了，所以很高兴一切顺利！

source: Haha, I guess I shouldn’t be surprised by your preparedness. You really are a scout at heart.
translation: 哈哈，我想自己不该惊讶于你的准备工作。你骨子里真的是个童军。

source: We have Buddy Law #1 to thank for that!
translation: 这都要感谢《伙伴法则》第一条！

source: I gotta say, Yoshi~ You picked the perfect spot for us to have a vacation!
translation: 我得说，Yoshi～你选的度假地点太完美了！

source: I knew you’d like this place! The beach is nice and private, with nobody telling us what to do!
translation: 我就知道你会喜欢这里！海滩漂亮又私密，没有人告诉我们该做什么！

source: You know what else is good about being somewhere so private~?
translation: 你知道在这么私密的地方还有什么好处吗～？

source: What?
translation: 什么？

source: I don’t have to worry about wearing anything! Just let it all hang loose and let the breeze flow through your legs.
translation: 我不用担心穿任何东西！就让一切自然垂落，让微风穿过你的双腿。

source: Haha, why am I not surprised that’s what you wanted to do?
translation: 哈哈，我怎么一点都不惊讶你想做的是这个？

source: Ahhh, this does feel good~
translation: 啊啊啊，这感觉真好～

source: Hehe, you know what will make this a lot better?
translation: 嘿嘿，你知道什么会让这一切更棒吗？

source: If we fooled around?
translation: 如果我们胡闹一番？

source: Dang it. You know me too well.
translation: 该死。你太了解我了。

source: You say that, but you’re already rock hard too!
translation: 你这么说，但你自己也已经硬得不行了！

source: What are we waiting for then?
translation: 那我们还等什么？

source: Ahh… This was the perfect day, Yoshi!
translation: 啊……今天真是完美的一天，Yoshi！

source: We got to swim and fool around all day, and to top it all off with a romantic sunset dinner… Damn you really outdid yourself this time!
translation: 我们一整天都在游泳、嬉闹，最后还一起享用了浪漫的日落晚餐……天啊，你这次真的太会安排了！

source: I’m glad you enjoyed it, Aiden…
translation: 我很高兴你喜欢，Aiden……

source: Heh! Just you wait for my turn and I’ll blow you away with my style!
translation: 嘿！等轮到我的时候，你就等着吧，我会用我的风格让你大吃一惊！

source: Oh yeah? I’d like to see you try.
translation: 哦，是吗？我倒想看看你试试。

source: Eh, I guess that’s a lotta work for simple me. How about I just blow you instead?
translation: 呃，我这个简单的人做那么多事也太辛苦了。要不我还是直接帮你吹吧？

source: Hahaha! Don’t you think we did lots of that already?
translation: 哈哈哈！你不觉得我们已经吹了很多次了吗？

source: Hehe~ You know I can’t get enough of you though, Yoshi~
translation: 嘿嘿～不过你知道我就是对你欲罢不能，Yoshi～

source: But eh, just chillin’ and watching the sunset with you is way better.
translation: 不过，和你一起悠闲地看日落可好多了。

source: Oh, really now? That doesn’t sound like you at all, Aiden.
translation: 哦，真的吗？这可一点都不像你，Aiden。

source: I’m serious! To think I’d be missing out on all of this if I had made a different choice.
translation: 我是认真的！真难以想象，如果我做了不同的选择，就会错过这一切。

source: Yeah… If it weren’t for that, I wouldn’t be sitting here with you…
translation: 是啊……如果不是那样，我也不会坐在这里陪着你……

source: I’m really glad you stayed, Aiden…
translation: 我真的很高兴你留下来了，Aiden……

source: Every moment I have with you is worth a thousand lifetimes.
translation: 和你共度的每一刻，都抵得上千百次人生。

source: I love you Aiden…
translation: 我爱你，Aiden……

source: I love you too...
translation: 我也爱你……
